types.description: GV2 left-side auxiliary block: 1 NO position contact and 1 NO fault contact

document.title: Manual Motor Starters, Controllers, and Protectors, 2520CT0001

modelingNotes: Historical manufacturer spelling GV2AD1010; source hyphen preserved. Exact order selection and circuit diagram inspected in manufacturer-authored 2001 catalog at public document mirror.

53-54: instantaneous normally open position contact. 97-98: normally open fault indication. Normal reference is breaker off/reset without fault indication. Historical p27 includes short-circuit, overload and undervoltage tripping. No transition timing or reset simulation is claimed.

The p27 timing chart has apparent labeling/state inconsistencies; normal states follow exact p58 diagram and p11 selection. Later GVAD1010 FAQ FA23920 mentions magnetic/thermal fault behavior only; successor equivalence is not asserted.

Passive screw-clamp contact endpoints are application-dependent. No permanent links or ganged relation: position indication and fault indication are distinct. Breaker power poles and other accessories are outside this type.

Conditional ratings, p26: instantaneous IEC Ith 6 A; AC-15 3.3 A at 230-240 V for 100000 operations; fault IEC Ith 2.5 A; AC-14 0.3 A at 230-240 V for 1000 operations. DC-13 at 24 V: instantaneous 6 A/100000 operations, fault 1 A/1000 operations. Other voltage limits differ. No assigned voltage, AC-only metadata or scalar rating is asserted.

connectionCoverage.notes: All four screw-clamp endpoints shown in exact GV2AD1010 wiring diagram are included: 53, 54, 97, 98. No additional power, return, PE, shield or communication connections are specified for this auxiliary block; host breaker and separate accessories are excluded.
